## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 4

Session 4 splits between the fort under siege and the hidden tunnels beneath the *principia*. Load all four maps before players join — transition at the exact cued moments.

### Scene → Map → Tokens

| Scene | Map File | Tokens to Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scene 0: Gate breach | `Maptool/maps/s4_fort_siege.html` (custom Vindolanda siege SVG), or `CastleWall`/`BridgeCheckpoint` as fallback | All PCs, Centurion_Varro, Guard ×8, Berserker ×4, Tribal_Warrior ×8 | Three simultaneous crises — split party likely. Brutus' agent (Quintus_Flavius renamed "Soldier") starts near shrine. |
| Scene 1: Council | `saalburg_plan.jpg` (reference only) | Legate_Corvinus, Tribune_Lucius, Centurion_Varro, Augur_Cassia, all PCs | No combat. Use fort floor plan for NPC positioning only. Vercingetorix's envoy: off-screen runner. |
| Scene 2: Preparation | `saalburg_plan.jpg` (reference only) | Same as Scene 1 | No new tokens. Players plan escort route on the floor plan. |
| Scene 3: Tunnels — Armory | `Maptool/maps/s4_tunnel_armory.html` | All PCs, Animated_Armor ×4 | Animated Armor = constructs (divine resonance), not undead. No Turn Undead vulnerability. |
| Scene 3: Tunnels — Choking Hall | `Maptool/maps/s4_tunnel_choking_hall.html` | All PCs, Cassia (if escort) | No combat tokens. Gas is environmental. Medicine DC 13 or Cassia spell to clear. |
| Scene 3: Tunnels — Elder Stair | `Maptool/maps/s4_tunnel_elder_stair.html` | All PCs, Quintus_Flavius (Brutus' agent) | Rockfall trap: Dex save DC 15 or 2d8 bludgeoning. |
| Scene 4: Antechamber | `NatureGoddessTemple` | All PCs, Augur_Cassia, Centurion_Varro, Legate_Corvinus | Same map as Ch1 altar chamber — intentional callback. No combat. Mars as voice only. |

**Scene 0 sub-maps (optional — run on same CastleWall map, adjust narrative):**

| Crisis | Focus area | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Gate breach | North gate section | 3 rounds of Athletics DC 14 before engineers arrive |
| Granary fire | West workshops area | Survival DC 15 each round; each failure = 1d6 rations lost |
| Shrine desecration | Shrine doorway | Insight DC 14 to spot agent; contested Dex to intercept |

### Map Files Location

Campaign session folder: `Maptool/maps/campaign/S4_The_Gods_Demand/`

```
s4_fort_siege.html     — custom Vindolanda siege overview SVG (Scene 0, preferred)
CastleWall             — fort wall battle map (Scene 0 fallback)
BridgeCheckpoint       — alternate gate map
saalburg_plan.jpg      — fort interior reference (Scenes 1–2, no battle grid)
s4_tunnel_armory.html      — Sunken Armory SVG battle map (Scene 3, 12×10 sq)
s4_tunnel_choking_hall.html — Choking Hall SVG battle map (Scene 3, 6×12 sq)
s4_tunnel_elder_stair.html  — Elder Stair SVG battle map (Scene 3, 14×14 sq, dry well)
NatureGoddessTemple    — circular stone chamber (Scene 4 antechamber)
```

Run `bash Maptool/build_campaign_maps.sh` to copy session tokens into this folder (idempotent).

### The Tunnel Callback

Scene 4's `NatureGoddessTemple` map is the same map used for the Ch1 altar chamber. This is intentional: the party arrives from a different direction (the old Roman water tunnel, not the excavation shaft), but the granite altar, the chain anchors in the floor, and the Wight's remains from Session 1 are all present. The session begins and ends in the same circle of stone.

Narrate the recognition: *"The altar. The chains. You've been here before."*
